# Version 4.150.1
> **GPU rendering corrections** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects Ganesh stencil handling and native text-buffer cleanup.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Stencil clear coverage** — Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))
- **Safer text-buffer cleanup** — Fixes a native use-after-free during cleanup after corrupt Slug data is rejected. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
